Prevenza bundles these open-source components for offline text reading (OCR). Nothing is loaded from the internet.

tesseract.js 7.0.0 (Apache-2.0)
tesseract.js-core 7.0.0 (Apache-2.0)
@tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0 (English model, tessdata best_int, Apache-2.0)
@tesseract.js-data/hin 1.0.0 (Hindi model, tessdata best_int, Apache-2.0)
@tesseract.js-data/tam 1.0.0 (Tamil model, tessdata best_int, Apache-2.0)

Regenerate with: npm run ocr:assets
